воевать.gloss: to fight in a war, wage war

meanings.en: to fight in a war, serve in wartime
meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'евать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fight in a war, wage war'.

examples.trans: Both grandfathers fought in the war.
My great-grandfather fought at the front.

examples.text: На родственников ничего нет. Оба деда воевали.
examples.trans: There's nothing on his relatives. Both grandfathers fought in the war.

related.gloss: aspect/prefix relative (to fight in a war)

examples.text: Не надо врать. Стену монастыря сносят!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

испугаться.gloss: to get scared, to be frightened

meanings.en: to get scared, to take fright
meanings.note: + genitive of what frightened you. Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'пугаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get scared, to be frightened', paired with 'пугаться'.

examples.trans: What is it, little guy, are you scared?

meanings.note: Question word. Core Russian adv meaning 'how; as' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: In an election or for a job. From Latin 'candidatus' ('clothed in white toga', worn by office-seekers in ancient Rome).

examples.trans: He is a candidate for mayor.

meanings.note: in the instrumental: 'кем ты работаешь?'

Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to have a look', paired with 'смотреть'.

meanings.note: Masculine animate noun. Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (stem 'атель'). Agent/instrument noun formed with the productive Slavic suffix '-тель' ('-er'). Common masculine noun meaning 'traitor' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Ничего я тебе не скажу, предатель!
examples.trans: I won't tell you anything, traitor!

meanings.note: On foot, once. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come, to arrive', paired with 'приходить'.

meanings.note: Plural: дети. Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'child' in everyday Russian.

+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'емья'). Common feminine noun meaning 'family' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Right, the Samsonov family. He's a builder, she's a nurse.

meanings.note: Feminine 3rd declension noun. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'праведливость'). Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common feminine noun meaning 'justice, fairness' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I fought for the sake of justice!

струсить.gloss: to chicken out, to lose one's nerve

meanings.en: to lose one's nerve, to be scared off
meanings.note: Perfective verb. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'трусить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to chicken out, to lose one's nerve', paired with 'трусить'.

examples.trans: He chickened out before the election.

examples.text: Не надо трусить в трудный момент.
examples.trans: Don't lose your nerve in a difficult moment.

examples.text: Он струсил, как его дед в войну!
examples.trans: He lost his nerve, like his grandfather during the war!

судить.gloss: to judge, to try in court

meanings.en: to judge, to evaluate, to put on trial
meanings.note: Imperfective verb. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'удить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to judge, to try in court', paired with 'осудить'.

examples.text: Только фашисты судили людей по крови!
examples.trans: Only fascists judged people by blood!

meanings.note: As opposed to before. Core Russian adv meaning 'now (from now on)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.text: Я воевал с тринадцати лет ради справедливости!
examples.trans: I fought from age thirteen for the sake of justice!

meanings.note: Не трогай! = Don't touch!. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to touch', paired with 'тронуть'.

examples.text: Всё, хорошо, я тебя выпущу! Только собаку не трогай!
